title: La Canasta: Argentina Daily Supermarket Prices
subtitle: Daily prices from 5 Argentine supermarkets and an INDEC-weighted index
description:
**La Canasta** is an independent daily price index of Argentine supermarkets: https://lacanastaindex.com

Every day a program collects more than 10,000 online prices at Carrefour, Jumbo, ChangoMás, Día and Coto. Using 567 products of 33 basic kinds (milk, bread, yerba mate, oil, cleaning and more), it calculates an index weighted with INDEC's official weights (ENGHo 2004/05, Greater Buenos Aires), published before the official CPI.

## Files
- **precios_diarios.csv**: every price collected, every day, at every shop (price paid with open promotions, list price, barcode, stock).
- **canasta.csv**: the 567 products the index follows, with barcodes.
- **indice_diario.csv**: the daily index (average of 24 to 30 Oct 2026 = 100), overall and per supermarket, price paid and list price.
- **indice_por_grupo.csv**: the index for each INDEC spending group.
- **inflacion_mensual.csv**: monthly figures.
- **ponderaciones.csv**: INDEC weights. **precios_excluidos.csv**: prices left out after daily review, with reasons.

Full description of every column in LEEME.md (Spanish and English). Method: https://lacanastaindex.com/metodo.html

## Ideas
Compare supermarkets for the same barcode, track promotions, measure food inflation in real time, detect shrinkflation.

Updated every week. Daily data and DOI: https://lacanastaindex.com/metodo.html#datos
